title: What handling equipment is needed when box-furnace quenching and washing share loading trays?
summary: A Suneng chamber-furnace line proposal connects heating furnaces, oil and water quench tanks and washing stations with an automatic fork-transfer vehicle. The washer separately has a gantry hook frame. Smooth whole-line movement requires checks of every receiving method, loaded-tray weight and available space. Repeated 600 × 600 × 500 mm dimensions do not establish compatibility.
